name: mcm-sofa
brief: a mid-century modern three-seat sofa: a long boxy seat with three olive green cushions and three back cushions, thin walnut base, short thick tapered walnut legs

name: mcm-floor-lamp
brief: a tall mid-century modern floor-standing lamp, as tall as a person: a thick walnut pole three times the height of its wide cream drum shade, standing on a round heavy brass disc base on the floor

name: retro-fridge
brief: a rounded retro refrigerator as tall as a person: mint green body with soft rounded corners, a thick chrome handle, one big door over a smaller bottom door, short thick feet

name: friendly-dinosaur
brief: a full-size friendly cartoon dinosaur figure of our own design, standing upright on its two thick back legs like a person, facing forward: teal green body, cream belly, round orange spots on its back, short arms, a long thick tail resting on the floor, a big friendly smile
